limitations: Two cold observations per arm and size; report both rather than a stable cold-tail estimate.
Warm repetitions reuse two caches per arm in one shared process; scheduling noise and cache overflow can affect per-call tails.
9216 accounts exceed the 8192-entry-per-cache capacity; no recorded hit/miss data proves the precise source of the scaling discontinuity.

Per-call timing excludes fixture creation, independent protocol root computation, JSON serialization/flush, account State parsing, SQL graph verification, Host budgets, PQ, full State root, networking and confirmation. Whole-command measurements include test setup and observation output.
No error/cancellation cohort, account/history fixed-W scaling, or end-to-end four-second hostile-business result is established by this successful-root assay.

cross_axis_findings.cold_open_interpretation: Whole native opener calls span 62.031582 to 2605.622008 ms. H=128 minus H=0 adds 1491.054379, 1200.898602 and 981.872522 ms at A=64, 1024 and 16384 respectively. Bounded measured header callbacks do not imply bounded recovery cost.

header_ancestors.observed_fit: All 81 successful/cancelled admission returns match 6 * min(parent_history_blocks, 16).
header_ancestors.scope: The observed counter plateaus by H=16 across all three A values. This finite matrix does not establish a bound for every history/state shape or deep reorganization.
header_ancestors.units: progress callback count, not a count of distinct ancestor identities

cross_axis_findings.wall_interpretation: Successful admission medians span 9.2742385 to 19.4610365 ms and activation medians 2.3739875 to 4.485728 ms across these cells. Account-scale wall results are not monotone in every H slice; eight samples on a shared host do not isolate causality or establish throughput.
cross_axis_findings.working_set_and_recovery: The fixed W=3 owner set does not make every cost constant: working reward keys change with H, witness/COW/query work grows with A, and whole cold opener time rises with A/H in broad trend but is not monotone in every slice. Retained COW nodes count persisted additions; separately measured successor-query point reads are diagnostic work outside the timed admission/activation, not total native SQL reads.

method.A: Preallocated dormant-account count; fixed three actual witness owners at every measured block.
method.H: Warmup history length. Eight successive measurements use parent heights H through H+7; deliberate cancellation uses H+8.
method.before_commit_return: Includes normal/error return processing; does not measure durable commit or fsync.
method.cold_reopen_scope: One whole Node opener call per cohort after dropping the prior Node. Complete-state equality is checked afterward; that post-open reference check and the separately timed journal differential are excluded from native_open_wall_ms. No OS page-cache eviction or new-process cold-start claim.
method.comparability_to_initial: Same descriptive aggregation structure as the earlier dirty-a10 observation. These sequential shared-container campaigns are not a randomized paired performance comparison, so no speedup or regression attribution is inferred between them.
method.excluded_from_native_stage_wall: Setup, warmup, signed-packet/work construction, full-state reference diagnostics and flushed return-journal IO; these remain in the campaign process cost.
method.host: Shared container; cohorts were sequential, not randomized repetitions on an isolated host.
method.input_validation: All 10 JSONL byte lengths and SHA-256 values match the strict readback; process stdout/stderr digests also match. All 153 actual native returns are counted once and matched to completed sample/cancellation records. Source/binary stability is separately established by final-cost-source-verification.json and the process receipt; this analysis does not fabricate execution attestation.
method.median: Arithmetic midpoint of the two central order statistics for n=8; median_interval gives those two observed order statistics, not a confidence interval.
method.native_stage_timing: Inclusive native call wall time only. No sums of nested offsets, persistence spans, or BeforeCommit-to-return intervals are formed.
method.quantiles: Descriptive empirical nearest-rank p25, p75, p95: sorted[ceil(q*n)-1]. At n=8 p95 equals the observed maximum; it is not a tail qualification. For each n=1 cancellation p25/p75/p95 are null and the median is only the single observed value.
method.separate_query_scope: Successor witness query is a separately instrumented diagnostic outside native admission/activation wall timings; its point_reads are not total SQL reads of those stages.
method.sql_changes_scope: SQLite total_changes records work performed, including rolled-back writes; positive cancelled changes do not imply durable published mutations.
method.touched_set_scope: W=3 is the exact witness-owner set observed for each of the 72 completed measured blocks; three owners do not imply three nodes, three database reads, or constant working obligation-key count.
method.wall_units: milliseconds; raw input nanoseconds remain authoritative
